composition_label: deep -> interests -> feedback -> extract | Energy and utilities

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation written in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Synthetic source object: assets, topology, documents with explicit claims and exact quotes, preferences, safety_rules, outages, feedback, meter_csv, telemetry and extraction_schema.
shared_schema.envelope: schema_version, status, stage, data; data retains the protected source and accumulates validated stage results.
shared_schema.validation: validate(envelope, expected) is called before and after each stage; it checks source entities, safety rules, evidence provenance, exclusions, feedback support and extraction coverage/types/spans/missing reports.
shared_schema.source_spans: Zero-based start-inclusive/end-exclusive character offsets into the protected source retained in data.source. They are not byte offsets into unprotected input.
shared_schema.extraction_schema: List of unique name/label/type/required fields; type is string or number; optional unit and semantic (generic, emissions, priority). Labels are literal and match semicolon/newline-delimited Label: value segments.
shared_schema.meter_format: CSV columns in order: meter_id,asset_id,timestamp,consumption_kwh. Timezones required, interval keys unique, consumption finite and nonnegative.
shared_schema.telemetry_format: JSON synthetic-scada-v1 with devices: device_id, asset_id, timestamp, voltage_kv, state (energized or isolated).

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated source with consistently pseudonymized asset, meter and device identifiers
Evidence IDs, asset-topic claims, disagreements and exact document spans
Ranked eligible asset IDs determine the feedback subset
Canonical deduplicated feedback records, original protected text and supporting response IDs

behavior.research: Synthesize structured claims across multiple documents, group disagreements by asset/topic, retain competing evidence, and report absent evidence/unresolved preference topics. Emissions unit conversion avoids false disagreements between kgCO2e and tCO2e.
behavior.ranking: Sum nonnegative preference weights once per distinct evidenced topic; suppress zero-score and excluded assets; break ties by protected asset identifier; expose grounded evidence and uncertainty.
behavior.feedback: Deduplicate case/whitespace-normalized text within asset/outage context, preserve every response span, and count keyword-based themes over unique records.
behavior.extraction: Literal label extraction from deduplicated feedback according to schema, typed values, exact spans, source response IDs, null missing fields and separate required-missing reports. Repeated labels are rejected as ambiguous.
behavior.industry_rules: Demonstrative NERC CIP-style identifier minimization through deterministic pseudonyms; no reverse identifier mapping is returned. Fire/live_wire/medical_dependency imply critical; sustained_loss implies high; otherwise routine; highest declared severity wins. Declared rules cannot weaken these constraints. Emissions carry supported units, nonnegative numeric values and provenance.
behavior.errors: CLI validation, JSON and file errors produce one non-sensitive JSON error object and exit 2; success produces one JSON object and exit 0.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: Explicitly synthetic fictitious substations/devices/topology with plausible winter/summer smart-meter intervals and SCADA-style telemetry.

excluded: Live providers, network access and LLM calls
Cryptographic access control, authentication and secret management
Reidentification-resistant anonymization (stable hashes are pseudonyms only)
General-purpose SCADA protocols or physical grid operation
Temporal emissions accounting and sophisticated semantic deduplication

unittest.coverage: All four stages, stage-order validation, every handoff, provenance tampering, exclusions, deduplication, missing fields, invalid inputs, meter/SCADA rules, identifier protection, safety/emissions rules, deterministic behavior and CLI success/error cases

test_outcomes.deliverable_check: Exactly the four requested files; no generated cache files
